segments.text: The protagonist of the story, a 22 years old fourth-year college student. Born into an ordinary family, and possesses a few talents. Due the his athletic skill and his talent in just about anything, he is often relied on by those around him. In June, during his fourth year at his college, he is an honors student who has already got a job offer from a large company. Since childhood, for many years, he has been in love with his younger sister Haruka.
"To protect the gentle smile of Haruka, our family and the world have to recognize our relationship, so us siblings can be tied together."

To fulfill this wish, he has devoted himself since elementary school, searching for the means (Answer) alone. In his mind, one is an adult who must face a rational logic and the reality, on the other, a child who cannot forget his feelings for his sister, contrary to his calm appearance, his mind is extremely unstable. He hates the world for not approving of their relationship, just because "they are siblings", and no other reason. Moreover, while he is convinced that he truly loves his sister, he has to give up because it might bring sorrow to her, still, he despises himself more than the world itself for not being able to give up completely.
Translated and edited from Getchu
本作の主人公で、大学四年生の22歳。
平凡な両親から産まれた、多少の才能を持つ。
運動神経も悪くなく、文武両道の基本何でも出来るその高い能力から、周囲からはよく頼られる。
大学四年の六月の段階で、既に大企業への内定も決まる優等生。
幼い頃から長年、妹の陽香に恋心を抱いている。
『優しい陽香の笑顔を失わない為、家族や世間に自分らの仲を認めてもらった上で、兄妹二人結ばれたい』
と真剣に願い、小学生の頃からその手段（答え）を求め、一人学問に打ち込んできた。
性格は、真面目で温厚。妹の面倒をずっと見てきたため、特に年下の女子には優しく、よく慕われる。
心の中には、磨き抜かれた理性で現実を直視しなければならないと迫る大人と、妹への恋心を忘れられない幼さが同居しており、落ち着いた外見とは真逆で、その精神は非常に不安定。
明確な理由もなく、『兄妹だから』というだけの理由だけで、自分たちの仲を認めてくれない世間が憎い。
また、妹を世界一愛していると確信する一方で、妹を不幸にしてしまうのだから諦めなければならないのに、それでも諦められずにいる自分自身を世間以上に、世界一嫌悪している。

The heroine of the story, Kei's younger sister, a third-year student at the school where Kei used to attend. Since she was raised in the comfort of her kind parents and an older brother, she is mild-mannered and well-behaved. Even though she is the younger sibling, she is generous and honest at heart, except when being spoiled by her older brother. If she does something wrong, she always admit it honestly. She always follows her parents' discipline, her gifted intelligence, and the back of her strong-willed (on the surface) brother, so she is also strong-willed, mature and able to face the reality. Her personality is more admirable than at the present.
"I'm in love with my brother, but our relationship has gone cold."

She acts coldly towards Kei, however, this is only on the surface. Ever since she was a child, her brother is always in her mind. She believes that the strength of her feelings is real and not on a whim. Even if her parents judge her, her feelings would not waver at all.

At the moment, in order to get close to her brother during their cold relationship period, she intentionally forgets her umbrella on rainy days and asks for him to come pick her up, along with using various other means, calling them coincidences.
Because of her disadvantaged life, she does not know "Affection", a self-sacrifice deviant with keen intellect, hence, she only waits for things to fade away.
Translated and edited from Getchu
本作のヒロインで、慧の妹。
兄の慧が通っていた学園に通う学園三年生。
優しい両親と兄に守られながら育ってきたので、その性格は起伏の波が少なく温厚。
二人兄妹の末っ子ながらも、兄へ甘えている時を除けば、心も寛大で正直者。
自分が悪ければ、素直に認められる良い子である。
両親からの躾と、生まれつきの聡明さ、そして（表面上は）人格者に見える兄の背中をずっと見てきたので、現実を直視出来るしっかりとした大人びた考えを持っている。
生来の性格は、現在よりもお人好し。
『兄である慧に恋をしているが、現在冷戦中』
慧に対して冷たい態度を取っているが、それが上辺だけであり、幼い頃からずっと兄である慧を一筋に想っている。
その恋心の強さは偏執というより確信。
例え両親から批判されようと、一切ぶれることはない。
現在は、冷戦中の兄の時間を何とか増やすため、雨の日は必ず傘を忘れて兄に迎えに来てもらうなど、偶然を装って様々な努力をしている。

The heroine of the story, a girl who looks exactly like Haruka and gives off a secluded feeling. Currently, she works at a hostess club, but those around her think that she is "a normal girl who does not stand out very much".
When she finds "someone lonely" at the club, she uses her body to heal them.

During her work at the club, she meets Kei, who reluctantly goes there with his friend. Even though he loves, watches over, and keeps an eye on his sister, Kei is very surprised to see that Mutsuki looks exactly like her.
Translated and edited from Getchu
本作のヒロインで、陽香とまったく同じ顔を持つ、超然とした雰囲気を纏う少女。
現在、キャバクラで働いているが、周りからの印象は『あまり目立たない普通の女の子』。
『寂しがり屋』のキャバクラ客を見つけては、その体を使って癒やしてきた。
勤め先のキャバクラに、親友に強引に連れて来られた慧と出会う。
妹を愛し、見守り、見続けてきた慧さえも、満月を見て驚愕するほど、陽香と瓜二つの容姿をしている。

The mother of Kei and Haruka, and a proud housewife who takes care of the house in place of her working husband. She is a beautiful woman with a warm and gentle atmosphere. There are no noticeable wrinkles on her face and her skin looks quite youthful, as a result of which she is often mistaken for being younger than she really is. Haruka's well-proportioned facial features are a result of the strong influence of her mother's genes.

She is the complete opposite of her unsociable husband and is very charming. Her affable nature and youthful appearance are such that even her more elderly mannerisms seem very endearing. She is cheerful and talkative and gets along very well with her neighbors.
Translated from the official website
主人公と陽香の母親。
働きに出ている夫のかわりに家を守る、誇りある専業主婦。
ほんわかとした雰囲気のある美人。
顔に目立った皺はなく、肌も瑞々しい。
よく若いと勘違いされる。
陽香の整った顔立ちは、母親の遺伝子を強く受け継いだためである。
無愛想な夫とは真逆で、非常に愛嬌がよく、若く見える容姿もあって、おばさん仕草さえ可愛らしく見える。
明るくお喋り好きで、ご近所との付き合いも非常に良い。

The father of Kei and Haruka, he is a salaryman who provides for his wife and two children well. He works as a supervisor at his company. Despite his stern face, he is a rather timid man with a gentle heart. He is a bit too gentle of character to survive in society, and the wrinkles on his face along with his rapidly greying hair are a testament to the hardships he has had to face.
He is a bit concerned at his rapidly aging appearance despite only being in his forties. He is secretly glad that both Kei and Haruka's facial features resemble those of his wife rather than him.
Translated from the official website
妻と子供二人を立派に養うサラリーマン。課長。
顔は厳ついが、心優しい、どちらかというと気弱な男性。
社会を生き抜くには、少し優しすぎる性格をしており、顔の皺と髪に混じる多めの白髪は男の苦労あり、勲章である。
まだ四十代だが、老けて見えるのが小さな悩み。
主人公と陽香の顔立ちは、どちらも母親似。
自分ではなく妻に似てくれたことを密かに喜んでいる。

Iko is a beautiful university professor with a peculiar background as a former doctor, who looks good in a lab coat, smoking a cigarette with a cynical smile. She is quarter-Dutch, with a Dutch grandmother. She is very mysterious and even the observant Kei cannot fathom what is going on in her mind. Like her father and herself, she comes from a family of doctors with intellectual backgrounds. However, Iko is especially talented and surpasses the rest of her family when it comes to intellect. Being a genius and a hardworker, as well as possessing the good looks she inherited from her mother, many people have high expectations for her future.
Translated from the official website
オランダ人の祖母を持つクォーター。
元医者という特異な経歴を持つ、タバコと白衣とニヒルな笑みの似合う美人教授。
観察眼の鋭い主人公でも、何を考えているのか一切悟らせないミステリアスさを持つ。
父親や自分がそうであったように、代々医師の家系で、一族は総じて頭脳に優れる。
特に亥子は才能に恵まれ、一族の中でも高い知能を持つ。
天才であると同時に努力家でもあり、母親譲りのその美貌もあって、大勢からその将来を嘱望された。

Miya is a third-year high school girl. With beautiful black hair and a calm, composed expression, she is a studious girl who can often be found poring over books. She only wears her glasses when reading books. When it comes to beauty, she isn't a match for Haruka and her popularity with boys, but her facial features are still well-proportioned enough for her to be categorized at the same level as Haruka in the girls' hierarchy, which is primarily decided based on looks. This allows her to spend her time with Haruka at school. While she's not really 'cute', her keen intellect, demeanor and beauty makes her appear cold and distant to others. She is a cool beauty with a mature atmosphere about her.
Translated from the official website
学園三年生の女の子。
黒髪と澄まし顔、本を読む姿が様になる文学少女。
眼鏡は読書するときだけ掛けるようにしている。
陽香ほど男子に人気が出る容姿ではないが、顔の整い方でグループ分けされる傾向のある女子ヒエラルキーにおいて陽香と一緒に学校生活が送れるほどには整っている。
可愛いではなく、鋭い知性と美しさがやや冷たい印象を与える。
大人びた雰囲気をまとったクールビューティー寄りの美人。

Daichi is a 22-year old freeter who is a friend of Kei. Skilled at making conversation, he is an excellent moodmaker who is great at creating a lively atmosphere. He is very friendly and can get along well with anyone, to the point of being overly familiar. He is a fantastic communicator, listener and smooth talker who is unmatched at entertaining others. He can also get along reasonably well with those of differing personalities and interests. Great at socializing, he is ready to even spend the night out if invited.
Translated from the official website
主人公の友人の22歳でフリーター。
得意の話術で場の空気を整え、雰囲気を盛り上げるムードメーカー。
お調子者で誰とでも親しくなれる。
悪く言えば、非常に馴れ馴れしい。
コミュニケーション能力が非常に優れ、聞き上手で口達者。
相手を楽しませるトーク術も優れる。
タイプも趣味も異なる人間ともそれなりに打ち解けられる。
人付き合いも非常に良く、遊びに誘われたら夜だろうと付き合ってくれる。
